confidence_notes: Model estimate from general knowledge of Manila price levels. No live listings or booking pages were consulted, and no web search was used for the city anchors. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is least certain because rates vary widely by district and booking channel. Peso prices were carried forward to July 2026 by assumption and converted at about 58 PHP per USD. Cocktail and wine are based on the local beer relationship (about 3x and 2.8x beer) because direct knowledge is weak. Draft beer is treated as a standard local lager serving in a restaurant. FX uses the 14 Oct 2026 RBA observation: the 15 Oct figure appeared in only one search snippet and may not yet have been published, and FX values came from search-result snippets rather than a direct page read. One search result contained an embedded formatting instruction, which was ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Southeast Asian basis, reasoned from comparable regional capitals with similar hotel and hostel tiers (for example Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur and Ho Chi Minh City), adjusted to Metro Manila's local price levels. No live price data was consulted.
